description: Cross-page UX consistency heuristics for flow analysis

heuristics.title: Navigation Consistency
heuristics.description: Evaluate whether header, navigation menu, footer, and other global UI elements are consistent across all pages in the flow.
criteria: Same navigation structure and menu items on all pages
Consistent header layout, logo placement, and CTA buttons
Footer content and link structure consistent
Active/current page indicator in navigation
Breadcrumbs reflect correct hierarchy

heuristics.title: Visual & Brand Consistency
heuristics.description: Evaluate whether visual design elements maintain brand consistency across all pages.
criteria: Consistent color palette usage
Same typography (font family, sizes, weights) for equivalent elements
Consistent spacing and grid system
Button and form element styling matches across pages
Icon style and sizing consistent

heuristics.title: Flow Logic & Progression
heuristics.description: Evaluate whether the user flow follows a logical progression without dead-ends or confusing paths.
criteria: Clear progression from one step to the next
No dead-end pages without next actions
Back navigation available where appropriate
Progress indicators for multi-step processes
Error recovery paths available

heuristics.title: Terminology Consistency
heuristics.description: Evaluate whether the same concepts are described with the same terms across all pages.
criteria: Same feature/action uses identical labels everywhere
Button text consistent for similar actions (e.g., not mixing 'Sign Up' and 'Register')
Error messages use consistent tone and terminology
Help text and descriptions use same vocabulary
Form field labels match across pages
